criteria.title: Draft v2 schema marker is represented in the domain model
criteria.assertion: SoulDraftContent exposes schema versioning constants and a schema field capable of distinguishing legacy/no-schema v1 drafts from soulfactory-draft/v2 drafts.
criteria.expected_result: v2 draft content reports soulfactory-draft/v2 while omitted schema reports soulfactory-draft/v1 for migration detection.

criteria.title: Customization nested specs round-trip
criteria.assertion: SoulDraftContent carries Persona, Avatar, Voice, and Memory fields using strongly typed nested specs with JSON tags matching the plan.
criteria.expected_result: Persona traits/system prompt sections, avatar generation/current refs, voice persona/provider settings, and memory search settings survive JSON serialization and parsing.

criteria.title: Legacy v1 fields remain migration-valid
criteria.assertion: Existing v1 fields such as avatar_prompt, assets.avatar_ref, assets.voice_ref, allowed_kinds, and tool_grants remain valid and are not dropped by migration helpers.
criteria.expected_result: MigrateToLatest returns a v2 copy that preserves legacy fields and additively seeds equivalent nested avatar/voice fields where possible.

criteria.title: Spec hash observes customization fields
criteria.assertion: Draft spec hash computation includes the new nested customization fields through canonical draft JSON serialization.
criteria.expected_result: Hashing the same v2 draft is stable, and changing a nested customization field changes the computed hash.

criteria.title: Memory specs map to OpenClaw memorySearch config
criteria.assertion: SoulMemorySpec is normalized into a portable soulfactory-memory-config/v1 contract and an OpenClaw agents.defaults.memorySearch-compatible config.
criteria.expected_result: Embedding provider/model, strategy, auto-index, retention metadata, top_k, score threshold, and reranking intent are preserved; OpenClaw receives provider/model/query/sync/session-memory fields.

criteria.title: Memory configuration validates provider and search fields
criteria.assertion: Bahia rejects unsupported memory providers/strategies, invalid top_k ranges, invalid score thresholds, negative retention, and rerank_model without rerank.
criteria.expected_result: Validation reports all invalid memory spec fields in a deterministic error message.

criteria.title: Memory configure params serialize into 38384 runtime control envelopes
criteria.assertion: Bahia can build params for RuntimeMethodMemoryConfigure without introducing REST or polling semantics.
criteria.expected_result: BuildRuntimeControlRequestEvent serializes soulfactory.memory.configure params containing the portable memory_config and OpenClaw memorySearch patch.

criteria.title: Personality spec maps to OpenClaw prompt sections
criteria.assertion: SoulPersonaSpec traits, style, tone, constraints, and system_prompt_sections are normalized and mapped into canonical OpenClaw role, guidelines, and red_lines sections.
criteria.expected_result: Explicit role/guidelines/red_lines content is preserved, traits/style/tone are appended to guidelines, and constraints are appended to red_lines.

criteria.title: Composite system prompt assembly is deterministic
criteria.assertion: The personality service assembles a composite system prompt from canonical sections in role, guidelines, red_lines order and omits empty sections.
criteria.expected_result: The assembled prompt uses stable section headers and ordering for reproducible runtime updates.

criteria.title: Persona fields are validated before runtime dispatch
criteria.assertion: Invalid persona traits, constraints, section names, duplicates, and disallowed control characters are rejected before building runtime params.
criteria.expected_result: Malformed persona specs return validation errors and do not produce runtime control params.

criteria.title: Persona update runtime params contract is defined
criteria.assertion: Bahia defines the soulfactory.persona.update method and the soulfactory-persona/v1 params payload for kind 38384 runtime control requests.
criteria.expected_result: Runtime params include normalized persona data plus OpenClaw system_prompt_sections and system_prompt_override fields using snake_case wire names; agent_defaults_patch carries OpenClaw-native config keys such as systemPromptOverride.
